abstract: A female patient presented with empyema thoracis and was planned for decortication. Peroperatively a cystic mass was found in the left lower lobe which was resected and diagnosed as a case of teratoma of lung on histopathological examination. This unusual case of primary intrapulmonary teratoma is being reported here.
abstract_ja: 女性患者が膿胸で受診し、胸膜剥皮術を予定していた。術中に左下葉に嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、これを切除した。病理組織学的検査で肺奇形腫と診断された。原発性肺内奇形腫というまれな症例を報告する。
